title: No hard Feelings
description: **No Hard Feelings** prevents friendly fire by blocking attacks on teammates and visually highlighting them with customizable armor colors. Designed for team play on **Fabric 1.20.1**, it features a smart friend list, quick commands
body:
> No Hard Feelings
Version: 1.20.1 (Fabric)
Requires: Fabric API

Description

The "No Hard Feelings" mod is the perfect solution for Team Mode. It automatically detects your teammates and repaints their armor in your chosen color (via command /fntcolor), which allows you to instantly distinguish allies from opponents in the hottest battle.

The main advantage: You will no longer be able to damage your own. Attacks on dedicated teammates are blocked, which completely eliminates friendly fire and misunderstandings in the team.

Additional functions:

A smart list of friends: Quickly add players to the mod's trusted list using a designated hotkey or the /fnt [nickname] command.

Full adaptation to Fabric 1.20.1.

Forget about random attacks on allies — focus only on winning together with No Hard Feelings!
